scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The Findings section mixes first-person consultant voice ('We identified', 'we find', 'we score', 'We score') with third-person passive constructions ('The audited set carries', 'machines lose structural context') within individual priority blocks, while the surrounding structural sections (Executive Summary, Balanced Scorecard, Agent Reading Pipeline) consistently use first-person 'we' throughout.
findings.context: **Finding:** We score Structured Data Quality at 63/100 (Good). The audited set carries a broad range of schema types already

findings.message: The Agent Reading Pipeline section opens in third-person ('Scoring a machine's metadata is not the same as scoring whether a machine can read each page at all. Pipeline Survivability runs eleven reading-resilience checks') but closes in first-person ('the one area we flag for attention'), mixing voices within the same section.
findings.context: Across the audited set, pipeline survivability scores at 97, and the one area we flag for attention is truncation risk

findings.message: Priority 1 uses the phrase 'every audited page' correctly in the finding body, but the At-a-Glance table entry states 'Unlabelled anchor links in site header, WCAG 4.1.2 (7 of 7 pages)' while the Priority 1 narrative then says 'a single theme edit resolves all seven instances' — the finding body asserts the issue is present across the full site header template as a site-wide fact rather than scoping it to the audited sample.
findings.context: Because the issue traces to a single recurring template pattern, a single theme edit resolves all seven instances.

findings.message: The llms-full.txt finding in the Discovery Files section hedges the recommendation with uncertainty ('the audited sample of 7 pages does not carry sufficient volume to determine whether adding llms-full.txt would deliver meaningful value') even though the absence of the file is a binary deterministic fact that warrants a direct recommendation, not deferred judgement pending a broader crawl.
findings.context: The audited sample of 7 pages does not carry sufficient volume to determine whether adding llms-full.txt would deliver meaningful value; we recommend revisiting this artefact once a broader crawl establishes the site's full content depth.
